blocks.html:
Where an ADU is served by gas piping, such piping shall be provided with:
   1.   Ready access for each occupant to shutoff valves serving the dwelling unit in which such occupant resides.
   2.   Ready access for each occupant to appliance shutoff valves serving appliances in the dwelling unit in which such occupant resides.
